newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Oman to free up 110,000 bpd crude contracts - MEES.
newsitem.headline: Oman to free up 110,000 bpd crude contracts - MEES.

text.p: Oman's Ministry of Petroleum and Minerals (MPM) is to offer 110,000 barrels per day (bpd) of crude in 1997 that is being lifted this year by Transworld and other John Deuss-related crude contracts, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) reported on Monday.
"The supplies will be divided up primarily among companies from Korea, Thailand and China," MEES reported.
MPM currently has direct crude contracts with 24 companies including Transworld, Commet and Hart Field which have connections to Deuss, MEES reported.
MPM recently severed its relationship with Deuss over disagreements on how future energy investment projects should proceed, industry sources said.
